the GA-mediated control of seed germination is a complex process that involves both biosynthesis and response.

GA biosynthesis is localized in the embryo, whereas the GA response is observed in the endosperm, and the embryo–endosperm interaction is essential for the regulation of Arabidopsis seed development.

The main takeaway from our work is that
GA biosynthesis and GA response are not restricted to the endosperm or radicle.
